text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. The purpose of this report is to extend the existing "No Stopping Anytime" regulation currently on both sides of Edgehill Road from Royal York Road to a point 40 metres east, to now be in effect between Royal York Road and Edgevalley Drive. The proposed parking amendment is the result of consultation with the local Councillor and will help reduce congestion and improve motorist safety in the area.

Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Amended the existing no stopping at all times on both sides of Edgehill Road, between Royal York Road and a point 40 metres east to be in effect from Royal York Road to Edgevalley Drive.
